label: PF Backlog 589
title: Contract-driven agent prompts: deprecate the hardcoded templates (design 3.1-3.10, architect 6.1-6.21) + remove .opencode refs
body:
## Problem / why
agents/design.agent.json and agents/architect.agent.json hardcode large mandatory templates (design.md 3.1-3.10; architect 6.1-6.21 NFR tables) that over-produce and are never derived from the contract. The architect prompt also references .opencode/tools/drawio/draw.io.exe (framework-dependency; guideline-4 violation).
## Goal & value
Prompts state 'minimum sufficient' + the section plan/ids come from the contract; only relevant/required sections are emitted; framework-agnostic.
## Acceptance criteria
- design/architect prompts no longer mandate the fixed 3.1-3.10 / 6.1-6.21 blocks; NFR mapping references the product-wide NFR ids (BI-PF-1373).
- No .opencode references in agents/*.agent.json.
## Approach
Rewrite the instructions to be contract-driven; drawio export best-effort via a neutral CLI name (skip if absent).
